description: In crates/transit/src/rnews_main.rs, parse_args() uses a manual while i < args.len() / i += 2 index walk. The idiomatic Rust approach is a peekable iterator: let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1).peekable(); with args.next() / args.peek(). This eliminates the off-by-one-prone index arithmetic and is more composable. Not a bug; low-priority style.
title: parse_args() uses index-walk instead of peekable iterator
